title: fix(cli): show actionable QR pairing failures alongside JSON
body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw qr --json` prints a generic failure and Doctor hint on stderr instead of the existing remedy when auth overrides conflict, access-profile flags conflict, `--remote` has no configured remote URL, or the pairing resolver refuses the configuration.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing expected-CLI-error owner at the four refusal sites. The messages are unchanged. Pairing resolution, authentication, access grants and setup-code generation are untouched.

## User Impact

JSON callers get the same stdout error envelope and exit code, plus the same useful stderr message text-mode callers already receive. Text-mode diagnostics and successful setup output retain their existing behavior.

## Evidence

Base: `2c4413a6abbfeb4ac23cd07b775a105586548af1`. Final candidate: `08adaa7f51fe4cf44aceced270a71c5e533b40d8` (production unchanged from paired-proof head `160ae20444bdb47b5077c95b74e14e2ca73cac94`).

- Host source tier through ocx, with isolated HOME/config/state, synthetic credentials and no Gateway: all four required refusals were run with --json and in text mode. Base JSON stderr has the generic failure/Doctor hint; candidate has the existing remedy. JSON stdout bytes, text-mode output and exit code 1 compare identically.
- Redaction condition cleared: validateMobilePairingUrl never interpolates URL credentials/userinfo. Its errors are static or include only fixed source labels. All label producers were checked against the exact PR blobs. A synthetic userinfo URL also produces only a static refusal, without either sentinel in output.
- Real successful controls pass in --json and --setup-code-only modes with exit 0. Only hashes are retained. Fresh bootstrap credentials and expiry necessarily make raw setup-code hashes differ; payload-contract and metadata-envelope hashes match after excluding those two fresh fields. No setup code or credential value appears in receipts.
- Vitest-source: qr-cli.test.ts is 5 forwarding failures / 15 passes on base and 20 passes on candidate. Existing distinct guard/resolver assertions remain; the duplicate new JSON fixture matrix was removed in favor of real root-CLI proof.
- Built-process consumer suite: all 43 cases in test/cli-json-stdout.e2e.test.ts pass against fresh candidate artifacts, including both qr/clawbot qr spellings and both conflicting option pairs. Its obsolete stderr expectations now require the remedy and reject the generic banner; JSON and exit-status assertions are unchanged.
- Targeted lint (zero warnings/errors), matching config-cli and root-other test typecheck leaves, and formatting pass. Production +5/-4; tests +15/-17, net -2; no allocation file.

Leon-SK668's original human commit is preserved. Both maintenance commits change tests only. No new error wording, config, permission, protocol, dependency or stored-data format is introduced.

Full tier passes on production-identical head `160ae20444bdb47b5077c95b74e14e2ca73cac94`: `ocx build --dts`, supported self-contained package/tarball integrity, packed version entry and packed QR JSON refusal smoke. The final commit changes only consumer assertions, so this full proof is reused. External dependencies came from the ocx-installed checkout; bundled workspace dependencies came from the tarball. The packed refusal emits the same JSON error envelope and existing remedy without generating setup output.

[Paired redaction, renderer, hash-control and test receipts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199650#issuecomment-6898076491).

## Merge Risk

Two-way door: a revert restores the old generic stderr behavior without migrating state. Blast radius is QR refusal diagnostics; successful pairing/authentication and setup-code output are unchanged.
